tested_scope: One end-to-end scheduled-Chat-native audit outcome route: read current authoritative repository controls through the connected GitHub repository API, apply the current hard-gate reasoning contract to those exact inputs, persist a machine-readable primary-verification verdict in the role-local audit namespace through GitHub Contents, then exact-read back that file. This scope does not test arbitrary code execution, hosted runners, Actions, Codespaces, artifacts, LFS, packages, external APIs/models, protected-primary execution, or general richer-mode outcome parity.

predecessor.continuation_consumed: Verify a distinct route that uses the repository transport primitive and adds a useful outcome step without broadening the transport-only pass into general parity evidence.

primary_sources.source: GitHub Docs: REST API endpoints for repository contents
primary_sources.verified_fact: Repository contents can be read, created and replaced through the Contents API; update requires the current blob SHA; Contents(read/write) permissions apply; conflicting create/update/delete content mutations must be serialized.

primary_sources.source: GitHub Docs: Rate limits for the REST API
primary_sources.verified_fact: REST requests are governed by time-window primary and secondary rate limits. Authenticated-user requests are generally limited per hour, and 403/429 rate-limit responses require waiting until a later allowed window rather than tight retry.

useful_outcome_step.input: Current manifest/lifecycle/root/downstream authority plus the predecessor verifier continuation.
useful_outcome_step.transformation: Apply the role's explicit hard gates and exact-scope policy to classify whether the concrete repository-read -> Chat reasoning -> repository-write/readback path itself can produce a durable audit verdict without a residual richer-mode/protected/user execution step.
useful_outcome_step.output: This immutable, machine-readable primary-verification verdict with exact authority identities, scope limits, hard-gate assessment and a nonempty next continuation.
useful_outcome_step.why_not_transport_only: The route produces a semantic audit classification from live authoritative inputs before persistence; the persisted object is the useful outcome, not merely a storage echo.

exact_chat_repository_evidence.write_probe: Creation of this role-local audit file through the authenticated GitHub contents surface.

hard_gate_assessment.rate_limit_dependency: Time-window GitHub API limits remain an interruption risk. The valid route is cross-invocation checkpoint/resume after the limit window, with no same-run wait/poll/backoff loop and no duplicate write.
hard_gate_assessment.scope_caveat: This verifies a narrow repository-audit outcome class only. It does not prove parity for arbitrary execution, browser automation, long-running jobs, external side effects, or protected-primary work.

classification.reason: Official GitHub documentation supports the repository read/write substrate and time-window rate-limit model, while the current Chat invocation supplies direct evidence that authoritative repository inputs can be read, semantically classified, persisted, and exact-read back without Work/protected/user execution. The pass is strictly limited to this repository-audit outcome class.

continuation: Next invocation: verify a different useful-outcome class that consumes repository state and produces a concrete non-audit artifact or state transition through scheduled Chat, with an explicit idempotency/conflict test. Reject it if any residual Work/protected/user execution, finite monthly/trial/paid quota, nonzero incremental cost, or same-run wait/poll/backoff dependency remains. Do not broaden this audit-route pass into general parity evidence.
